title: The detoxifying ally for menopausal skin
summary: Menopause is a key step in a woman’s life, marked by significant biological transformations. As a result of the cessation of menstruations, it has been shown that menopause causes increased levels of iron in the skin and an accumulation of ferritin, an iron storage protein
